# ReasBook-private

**ReasBook-private** is a Lean 4 project for formalizing mathematics from textbooks and research papers, generated by the tool [M2F](https://github.com/optsuite/M2F.git). It extends [ReasBook](https://github.com/optpku/ReasBook) with additional sub-libraries from [ALLBOOKS](https://github.com/optpku/ALLBOOKS).

---

## Current Coverage

| Book | Contributors |
|------|-------------|
| Terence Tao, *Analysis II*, 4th ed., 2022 | Chenyi Li, Min Cui, Qiming Dai, et al. |
| Rockafellar, *Convex Analysis*, 1970 | 20+ contributors |
| Jiri Lebl, *Introduction to Real Analysis, Volume I*, 2025 | Zichen Wang |
| Conforti et al., *Integer Programming*, 2014 | 36+ contributors |
| Achim Klenke, *Probability Theory: A Comprehensive Course*, 3rd ed. | |
| Bauschke & Combettes, *Convex Analysis and Monotone Operator Theory in Hilbert Spaces* | |
| Magnus, Karrass & Solitar, *Combinatorial Group Theory* | |
| Beck, *First-Order Methods in Optimization* | |
| May, *A Concise Course in Algebraic Topology*, revised | |
| Nesterov, *Lectures on Convex Optimization*, 2nd ed. | |
| Forster, *Lectures on Riemann Surfaces* | |
| Serre, *Linear Representations of Finite Groups* | |
| Lee, *Introduction to Smooth Manifolds*, 2nd ed. | |
| Cartan, *Differential Forms* | |
| The Stacks Project | |
| Reaslib (optimization library) | |

### Papers

- Nesterov, "Smooth minimization of non-smooth functions," *Mathematical Programming*, 2005
- Maassarani, "On Some Local Rings," arXiv:2512.19197v1, 2025
